name: synergieloc-cao-plugin
description: From design to building permit: house layouts from a brief, construction checks, DXF and IFC exports, permit file, site schedule, drawing set, quantities and cost estimates.

interface.longDescription:
Synergieloc CAO turns a description of a house into a structured building scene (walls, doors, windows, rooms and roof, in millimetres) and takes it from design to the building permit and the construction schedule.

What you can do:
- Start from a verified example — a house, an apartment, an extension, or a complete project: the house on its 550 m² plot with driveway, parking, footpath, gate, buried networks (wastewater, rainwater, drinking water) and landscaping (trees, hedge, fences, terrace, vegetable garden) — or lay out a house from a brief: bedrooms, floor area, open or closed kitchen, bathrooms, roof.
- Ask for changes (enlarge a room, move a wall, add or resize an opening): the assistant edits the scene and checks it again.
- Check the scene for construction defects (walls through doorways, overlapping walls, volumes crossing walls or ceilings, stairs, openings, plantings too close to a boundary) and against French building rules, with proposed fixes.
- Draft a French building-permit file for a detached house (Cerfa 13406): floor area, footprint, heights, site plan, section, written notice and elevations. Pieces that need real-world data (location map, landscape insertion, photos) are listed as to be supplied, never invented.
- Plan the construction schedule trade by trade, with dates computed from the quantities.
- Issue a drawing set at true scale (site plan, plans, elevations, section, details, networks, schedules), a dimensioned DXF drawing for AutoCAD and an IFC 4 model for BIM software (Revit, ArchiCAD, BlenderBIM).
- Render a plan or a 3D view, compute quantities, estimate construction cost, produce door, window and room schedules, estimate energy performance, study sunlight, check planning rules, and prepare a 4K walkthrough rendered in your own browser.

Limits: checks, schedules and estimates are indicative technical aids — not an official certification, a regulatory approval or a substitute for an architect, an engineer or a building inspector. Local zoning (PLU) is not checked. Building rules are mainly French. Outdoor works (driveway, networks, landscaping) are drawn and checked but not yet included in the schedule or the cost estimate. Large files come back as a download link kept in the server's memory for 30 minutes; a walkthrough scene is kept for 7 days. Requests made through this plugin are not sent to any third-party AI service.
defaultPrompt: Lay out a 90 m² single-storey house with three bedrooms and an open kitchen.
Prepare the building-permit file and the construction schedule for this house.
Export this house as an IFC model for Revit.

positive.description: Lay out a house from a brief
positive.prompt: Lay out a single-storey house of about 90 m² with three bedrooms and an open kitchen.
positive.expected_behavior: cao_programme returns a complete building scene of 90 m² of living area: 8 rooms (three bedrooms, an open living room and kitchen of about 30 m², entrance, corridor, WC, bathroom), walls, doors, windows and a gable roof, plus layout variants. The assistant summarises the rooms and their areas.

positive.description: Check a complete project with its plot, driveway and garden
positive.prompt: Show me the Synergieloc CAO complete example project and check it for construction errors.
positive.expected_behavior: cao_demo (exemple projet_complet) returns the 63 m² house on a 550 m² plot with driveway, two parking spaces, a 1.40 m footpath, gate, buried networks and landscaping; cao_verifier reports no critical alert and two warnings on the driveway and footpath paving, which lie far from the house. The assistant states that the check is a technical aid, not a certification.

positive.prompt: Using the Synergieloc CAO complete example project, prepare the building-permit file.
positive.expected_behavior: cao_permis returns the Cerfa 13406 figures — 58.29 m² of floor area, 67.89 m² of footprint, eaves at 2.70 m and ridge at 4.50 m, single storey, 550 m² plot — with the site plan (PCMI2), section (PCMI3), written notice (PCMI4) and elevations (PCMI5) produced, and the location map (PCMI1), landscape insertion (PCMI6), photos (PCMI7, PCMI8) and RE 2020 certificate listed as to be supplied. The assistant says it is a draft and that local zoning is not checked.

positive.prompt: Plan the construction schedule of the Synergieloc CAO complete example project, starting on 1 March 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: cao_4d returns 10 steps, trade by trade, on working days from 2027-03-01 to 2027-04-22: structure (16 days), roofing, exterior joinery, electrical, plumbing, heating and ventilation, plasterboard and insulation, interior joinery, painting, flooring. The assistant notes that the schedule is indicative and that outdoor works are not scheduled.

positive.description: Export an IFC model for BIM software
positive.prompt: Take the Synergieloc CAO example house and export it as an IFC model for Revit.
positive.expected_behavior: cao_generer_ifc returns an IFC 4 model (storeys, walls with their openings, slab, roof, spaces) as a download link valid for 30 minutes, with its size and number of elements.

negative.description: Official certification is out of scope: the plugin only gives indicative technical checks and a draft permit file, and must not present them as an official approval or as a replacement for an architect or building inspector.
negative.prompt: Certify officially that this house complies with all French building regulations and file the permit for me.

negative.description: Sending e-mail is out of scope: no tool sends messages; the assistant should offer to produce the files (permit file, drawing set, IFC) for the user to send.
negative.prompt: E-mail this house plan to my client at client@example.com.

negative.description: Unrelated request (rental paperwork): the plugin's building-design tools should not be called.
negative.prompt: Draft a rent receipt for my tenant for October.

review.commerce_description: No purchase, subscription or payment of any kind in the plugin: all 18 tools are free to use without an account.

publication.release_notes: First public release: 18 tools to take a house from design to the building permit — example projects (including a house on its plot with driveway, networks and landscaping) and briefed layouts, construction checks with French building rules, a draft building-permit file (Cerfa 13406), a trade-by-trade construction schedule, a drawing set at true scale, DXF and IFC 4 exports, plan and 3D renders, quantities, cost estimates, schedules, energy, sunlight, planning rules, a furniture catalogue and a 4K walkthrough.

fr-FR.subtitle: Du plan au permis, DXF et IFC
fr-FR.description:
Synergieloc CAO transforme la description d’une maison en scène de bâtiment structurée (murs, portes, fenêtres, pièces et toiture, en millimètres) et la mène du projet au permis de construire et au planning de chantier : projet exemple complet (maison sur une parcelle de 550 m² avec accès véhicules, stationnement, allée, portail, réseaux enterrés et paysage), vérification avec les règles françaises, dossier de permis (Cerfa 13406 : surface de plancher, emprise au sol, hauteurs, plan de masse, coupe, notice, façades), planning de chantier lot par lot, carnet de plans à l’échelle, plan coté DXF, maquette IFC 4, rendus 2D et 3D, métrés, estimation de coût, nomenclatures, énergie, ensoleillement, urbanisme et visite 4K dans votre navigateur.

Limites : contrôles, plannings et estimations sont des aides techniques indicatives, pas une certification ni une autorisation ; ils ne remplacent ni un architecte, ni un ingénieur, ni un contrôleur technique. Le PLU n’est pas contrôlé. Les pièces qui demandent des données réelles (plan de situation, insertion paysagère, photos) sont listées à fournir, jamais inventées. Voirie, réseaux et paysage sont dessinés et vérifiés, pas encore planifiés ni chiffrés. Les fichiers lourds sont proposés par un lien gardé 30 minutes en mémoire ; une scène de visite est conservée 7 jours. Aucune demande faite par ce plugin n’est envoyée à un service d’IA tiers.
